_about: Manual stat adjustments on top of the VS Battles baseline (see docs/STAT_RULES.md). Keys are game ids. Fields: abl / dur / str / spd add points; abl_min / dur_min set floors. Each entry cites the abilities it relies on. Hax that decides fights regardless of raw power gets a floor; everything else is a small add.
